<script>
window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    var x = 0;
    var timer = setInterval(function () {
        var confirmation = document.querySelector('.wpforms-confirmation-container-full');
        if (
            confirmation &&
            confirmation.getClientRects().length > 0 &&
            window.getComputedStyle(confirmation).visibility !== 'hidden'
        ) {
            if (x === 0) {
                gtag('event', 'ua_ga_forms_on_website', {
                    event_category: 'form',
                    event_label: window.location.pathname
                });
                x = 1;
            }
            clearInterval(timer);
        }
    }, 250);

    // Track telephone link clicks
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(function (link) {
        var href = link.getAttribute('href') || '';
        if (href.toLowerCase().startsWith('tel:')) {
            link.addEventListener('click', function () {
                gtag('event', 'ua_ga__calls_on_website_', {
                    event_category: 'number',
                    event_label: this.getAttribute('href')
                });
            });
        }
    });
});
</script>

<!-- nifty-required-fields:start -->
<script>
(function(){
  function userFields(scope){
    return [].slice.call(scope.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea')).filter(function(el){
      var t=(el.getAttribute('type')||'text').toLowerCase();
      if(el.tagName==='INPUT'&&(t==='hidden'||t==='submit'||t==='button'||t==='radio')) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }
  function enhance(form){
    if(form.__niftyReq) return; form.__niftyReq=true;
    var panels=[].slice.call(form.querySelectorAll('.panel'));
    var stepRadios=[].slice.call(form.querySelectorAll('input[type=radio]')).filter(function(r){
      return /step/i.test(r.name||'') || !!form.querySelector('label[for="'+(r.id||'')+'"]');
    });
    userFields(form).forEach(function(el){ el.required=true; });

    function visibleIdx(){
      for(var i=0;i<panels.length;i++){ if(panels[i].offsetParent!==null) return i; }
      return 0;
    }
    function firstInvalid(list){ for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++){ if(!list[i].checkValidity()) return list[i]; } return null; }
    function isBlank(el){ return el.value==null || (''+el.value).trim()===''; }
    function firstBlank(list){ for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++){ if(list[i].required && isBlank(list[i])) return list[i]; } return null; }

    [].slice.call(form.querySelectorAll('label[for]')).forEach(function(lab){
      var targetRadio=form.querySelector('[id="'+lab.getAttribute('for')+'"]');
      var targetIdx=stepRadios.indexOf(targetRadio);
      if(targetIdx<0) return;
      lab.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        var cur=visibleIdx();
        if(targetIdx>cur){
          var bad=firstInvalid(userFields(panels[cur]||form));
          if(bad){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); bad.reportValidity(); }
        }
      }, true);
    });

    form.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
      var all=userFields(form);
      var bad=firstBlank(all) || firstInvalid(all);
      if(bad){
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        var panel=bad.closest ? bad.closest('.panel') : null;
        var idx=panels.indexOf(panel);
        if(idx>=0 && stepRadios[idx]) stepRadios[idx].checked=true;
        setTimeout(function(){ try{ bad.reportValidity(); bad.focus(); }catch(_){ } }, 0);
      }
    }, true);
  }
  function run(){ [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('form.qf')).forEach(enhance); }
  if(document.readyState!=='loading') run();
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', run);
  window.addEventListener('load', run);
})();
</script>
<!-- nifty-required-fields:end -->
